name: Israel And The End Times
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God promises to regather Israel from the nations where they have been scattered and restore them to their own land, as affirmed in Ezekiel 11:17 and 36:24. This restoration is tied to the end times, when God will bring back the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem (Joel 3:1) and Israel will rebuild and inhabit their cities once more (Amos 9:14). The prophetic timeline includes a covenant confirmed for a specific period, followed by a time of desolation marked by abominations (Daniel 9:27), accompanied by cosmic signs such as wonders in the heavens and on earth (Joel 2:30), all pointing to the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan centered on Israel in the last days.
